summary: Implemented the rich.progress open and wrap_file feature across rich/progress.py (private _ProgressReader and _ProgressContext, module-level open and wrap_file, Progress.open and Progress.wrap_file methods), tests/test_progress.py (19 new tests before the script-entry block), docs/source/progress.rst (two new subsections under Advanced usage), and CHANGELOG.md (one Added bullet linking PR 1759). Changes are insertions only and nothing is committed. Tests, mypy, and black were not run, per instructions. Unverified: the `# type: ignore[return-value, type-var]` on the module-level open return may be unused under strict mypy, and Python 3.6/3.7 import behaviour is unchecked.
